name: comprehend
description: Amazon Comprehend is an Amazon Web Services service for gaining insight into the content of documents.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-dominant-language
subcommands.description: Determines the dominant language of the input text for a batch of documents.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-entities
subcommands.description: Inspects the text of a batch of documents for named entities and returns information about them.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-key-phrases
subcommands.description: Detects the key noun phrases found in a batch of documents.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-sentiment
subcommands.description: Inspects a batch of documents and returns an inference of the prevailing sentiment, POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, MIXED, or NEGATIVE, in each one.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-syntax
subcommands.description: Inspects the text of a batch of documents for the syntax and part of speech of the words in the document and returns information about them.

subcommands.name: batch-detect-targeted-sentiment
subcommands.description: Inspects a batch of documents and returns a sentiment analysis for each entity identified in the documents.

subcommands.name: classify-document
subcommands.description: Creates a classification request to analyze a single document in real-time.

subcommands.name: contains-pii-entities
subcommands.description: Analyzes input text for the presence of personally identifiable information (PII) and returns the labels of identified PII entity types such as name, address, bank account number, or phone number.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates a dataset to upload training or test data for a model associated with a flywheel.

subcommands.name: create-document-classifier
subcommands.description: Creates a new document classifier that you can use to categorize documents.

subcommands.name: create-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a model-specific endpoint for synchronous inference for a previously trained custom model For information about endpoints, see Managing endpoints.

subcommands.name: create-entity-recognizer
subcommands.description: Creates an entity recognizer using submitted files.

subcommands.name: create-flywheel
subcommands.description: A flywheel is an Amazon Web Services resource that orchestrates the ongoing training of a model for custom classification or custom entity recognition.

subcommands.name: delete-document-classifier
subcommands.description: Deletes a previously created document classifier Only those classifiers that are in terminated states (IN_ERROR, TRAINED) will be deleted.

subcommands.name: delete-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes a model-specific endpoint for a previously-trained custom model.

subcommands.name: delete-entity-recognizer
subcommands.description: Deletes an entity recognizer.

subcommands.name: delete-flywheel
subcommands.description: Deletes a flywheel.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource-based policy that is attached to a custom model.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset
subcommands.description: Returns information about the dataset that you specify.

subcommands.name: describe-document-classification-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a document classification job.

subcommands.name: describe-document-classifier
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a document classifier.

subcommands.name: describe-dominant-language-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a dominant language detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoint
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a specific endpoint.

subcommands.name: describe-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with an entities detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-entity-recognizer
subcommands.description: Provides details about an entity recognizer including status, S3 buckets containing training data, recognizer metadata, metrics, and so on.

subcommands.name: describe-events-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the status and details of an events detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-flywheel
subcommands.description: Provides configuration information about the flywheel.

subcommands.name: describe-flywheel-iteration
subcommands.description: Retrieve the configuration properties of a flywheel iteration.

subcommands.name: describe-key-phrases-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a key phrases detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-pii-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a PII entities detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Gets the details of a resource-based policy that is attached to a custom model, including the JSON body of the policy.

subcommands.name: describe-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a sentiment detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-targeted-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a targeted sentiment detection job.

subcommands.name: describe-topics-detection-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties associated with a topic detection job.

subcommands.name: detect-dominant-language
subcommands.description: Determines the dominant language of the input text.

subcommands.name: detect-entities
subcommands.description: Detects named entities in input text when you use the pre-trained model.

subcommands.name: detect-key-phrases
subcommands.description: Detects the key noun phrases found in the text.

subcommands.name: detect-pii-entities
subcommands.description: Inspects the input text for entities that contain personally identifiable information (PII) and returns information about them.

subcommands.name: detect-sentiment
subcommands.description: Inspects text and returns an inference of the prevailing sentiment (POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, MIXED, or NEGATIVE).

subcommands.name: detect-syntax
subcommands.description: Inspects text for syntax and the part of speech of words in the document.

subcommands.name: detect-targeted-sentiment
subcommands.description: Inspects the input text and returns a sentiment analysis for each entity identified in the text.

subcommands.name: detect-toxic-content
subcommands.description: Performs toxicity analysis on the list of text strings that you provide as input.

subcommands.name: import-model
subcommands.description: Creates a new custom model that replicates a source custom model that you import.

subcommands.name: list-datasets
subcommands.description: List the datasets that you have configured in this Region.

subcommands.name: list-document-classification-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the documentation classification jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-document-classifier-summaries
subcommands.description: Gets a list of summaries of the document classifiers that you have created

subcommands.name: list-document-classifiers
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the document classifiers that you have created.

subcommands.name: list-dominant-language-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the dominant language detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-endpoints
subcommands.description: Gets a list of all existing endpoints that you've created.

subcommands.name: list-entities-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the entity detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-entity-recognizer-summaries
subcommands.description: Gets a list of summaries for the entity recognizers that you have created.

subcommands.name: list-entity-recognizers
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the properties of all entity recognizers that you created, including recognizers currently in training.

subcommands.name: list-events-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the events detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-flywheel-iteration-history
subcommands.description: Information about the history of a flywheel iteration.

subcommands.name: list-flywheels
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the flywheels that you have created.

subcommands.name: list-key-phrases-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Get a list of key phrase detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-pii-entities-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the PII entity detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-sentiment-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of sentiment detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with a given Amazon Comprehend resource.

subcommands.name: list-targeted-sentiment-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of targeted sentiment detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: list-topics-detection-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the topic detection jobs that you have submitted.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to a custom model.

subcommands.name: start-document-classification-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous document classification job using a custom classification model.

subcommands.name: start-dominant-language-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous dominant language detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous entity detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-events-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous event detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-flywheel-iteration
subcommands.description: Start the flywheel iteration.This operation uses any new datasets to train a new model version.

subcommands.name: start-key-phrases-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous key phrase detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-pii-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous PII entity detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous sentiment detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-targeted-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous targeted sentiment detection job for a collection of documents.

subcommands.name: start-topics-detection-job
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous topic detection job.

subcommands.name: stop-dominant-language-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a dominant language detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops an entities detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-events-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops an events detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-key-phrases-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a key phrases detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-pii-entities-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a PII entities detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a sentiment detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-targeted-sentiment-detection-job
subcommands.description: Stops a targeted sentiment detection job in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-training-document-classifier
subcommands.description: Stops a document classifier training job while in progress.

subcommands.name: stop-training-entity-recognizer
subcommands.description: Stops an entity recognizer training job while in progress.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a specific tag with an Amazon Comprehend resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a specific tag associated with an Amazon Comprehend resource.

subcommands.name: update-endpoint
subcommands.description: Updates information about the specified endpoint.

subcommands.name: update-flywheel
subcommands.description: Update the configuration information for an existing flywheel.
